newsitem.title: USA: GM's Oldsmobile Intrigue to start at $21,250.
newsitem.headline: GM's Oldsmobile Intrigue to start at $21,250.

text.p: General Motors Corp.'s Oldsmobile Division said Thursday its new Intrigue mid-size sedan will carry U.S. prices ranging from $21,250 to $26,450, including a $550 destination charge.
Standard equipment on the $21,250 base Intrigue model includes automatic transmission, 16-inch aluminum wheels, air conditioning; power windows and door locks, cruise control and tilt steering wheel.

The upper-level Intrigue GL, starting at $22,650, adds a power driver's seat, remote keyless entry, automatic dual-zone air conditioning, fog lamps, and leather trim on the steering wheel, shifter and armrest.
"The Intrigue offers the refinement of Asian models, the ride and handling of European cars -- and all at a better price," Oldsmobile Intrigue brand manager Ken Stewart said in a statement.

A fully loaded Intrigue GL with leather seating, sunroof, BOSE stereo and the "Autobahn" package would top out at $26,450, Oldsmobile said, adding that the price also is below comparably equipped competitors.
